pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with moderately sharp pixel-level edge gradients. Patch spatial area is relatively consistent across the shoulder and flank, becoming slightly more elongated on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter negative-space pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform throughout the visible shoulder region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, jagged 1D silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck line, exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-colored avian subject (oxpecker) perched vertically on the lateral surface of the mid-neck.
